components-tooltip--default.name: Default
components-tooltip--default.description: Point at the icon button for 500ms, or tab to it, to show its tooltip. Press `Escape` to close it.

components-tooltip--placements.name: Placements
components-tooltip--placements.snippet:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { TooltipDirective } from './tooltip.directive'; import { TooltipComponent } from './tooltip.component'; import { IconButtonComponent } from '../icon-button/icon-button.component'; import { IconPlusComponent, IconXmarkComponent } from '@dnd-mapp/ui/icons'; @Component({ selector: 'app-demo', imports: [TooltipDirective, TooltipComponent, IconButtonComponent, IconPlusComponent, IconXmarkComponent], template: `
`, }) export class DemoComponent {}
components-tooltip--placements.description:
An icon button with a tooltip on each side. Once one tooltip shows, sweep the pointer along the row: the next one
shows at once.

components-tooltip--disabled-trigger.name: Disabled Trigger
components-tooltip--disabled-trigger.description:
A tooltip on a disabled icon button. It still shows on hover and on keyboard focus, because a disabled icon button
stays focusable.

components-tooltip--examples.description:
The groups of the `Tooltip` Figma page, with each tooltip drawn beside its trigger by `dma-tooltip` itself. Tab to
the last icon button to see the focus ring of the `Focused trigger` group. The Figma page uses glyphs that
`@dnd-mapp/ui/icons` doesn't have yet, so these use `xmark` and `plus`.
